text:
sam_support: FYI customer (Acme Corp) reporting recurring card declines for their vendor FlyAway Inc. Happens on monthly invoice charge. Customer pasted tx id 9f8a7c2e and says this has failed 3 cycles in a row. Can someone triage?

maria_billing: Can you paste the gateway response / decline code? Also need masked PAN and merchant id if available.

sam_support: Pasting gateway snippet from payments logs:```{\n  \"tx_id\": \"9f8a7c2e\",\n  \"status\": \"declined\",\n  \"decline_code\": \"MCC_BLOCK\",\n  \"mcc\": \"4511\",\n  \"merchant_id\": \"M-123456789\",\n  \"masked_pan\": \"4111********1111\",\n  \"reason\": \"merchant category blocked by customer policy\"\n}```

lee_ops: quick check — is there a PO on the invoice? Company policy sometimes blocks non-PO spend and card tokenization can fail if invoice metadata mismatch.

sam_support: Customer says vendor invoices are PO-less (they rely on recurring billing). They also said they didn't change policy recently.

priya_cardops: MCC 4511 = air carriers / airlines. Acme's corporate card policy currently blocks travel-related MCCs by org policy (last updated 2025-10-04). That explains MCC_BLOCK. Two paths: (1) create an MCC exception for merchant_id M-123456789 (safe if it's a known vendor), or (2) advise customer to add PO/submit vendor to procurement for approval so policy can be relaxed. Which does customer prefer?

maria_billing: If we do exception, we should log an audit entry and set an expiry (e.g., 30 days) until PO/process completes. Also confirm merchant name & descriptor to avoid opening to other airlines.

sam_support: Customer asked for a short-term fix while they sort POs. They gave merchant descriptor: \"FLYAWAY TRAVEL US\" and confirm merchant id matches M-123456789.

priya_cardops: I can apply a merchant-specific MCC exception. Creating card ops ticket and will notify payments provider to allow pre-auths for that MID. Also advise customer to attach a PO to upcoming invoices.

billing-bot: Ticket created: CARDOPS-2217 - "Temporary MCC exception for Acme Corp / FlyAway Inc (M-123456789)". Assignee: priya_cardops. ETA 2 business hours.

lee_ops: Implementation notes for audit: add exception record: {org: Acme Corp, mid: M-123456789, mcc: 4511, allow_until: 2026-01-15, reason: recurring invoice, PO pending}. Also set console flag so finance sees non-PO spend.

priya_cardops: Done — created exception and enabled through gateway. Applied expiry 2026-01-15. I pushed backend change and flagged audit record.

sam_support: Customer confirmed retry on next billing cycle — will monitor. Also asked if vendor could change MCC — any notes?

priya_cardops: Vendor changing MCC is usually up to acquirer + how vendor configures terminal/processor. We can recommend to customer to ask FlyAway to ensure MCC maps to 4722 (travel agencies) if that aligns with their policy, but merchant-specific exception is faster.

maria_billing: Follow-up action: email customer with steps: 1) temporary exception applied, 2) please attach PO to future invoices or request procurement approval, 3) if FlyAway changes MCC we may remove exception earlier. Ticket CARDOPS-2217 will be kept open until 2026-01-20 for verification.

priya_cardops: Marking resolved from ops side. Leaving ticket open for confirmation.

sam_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thx team :thumbsup:
